SELECT SEC_INFO.SEC_ID secId, SEC_INFO.BOND_NAME bondName, SEC_INFO.BOND_ABBREVIATION bondAbbreviation, SEC_INFO.TRADING_PLACES tradingPlaces, SEC_INFO.REGISTERED_CUSTODIAN registeredCustodian, SEC_INFO.ISSUER, SEC_INFO.RAISE_MODE raiseMode, SEC_INFO.DOMESTIC_AND_FOREIGN domesticAndForeign, SEC_INFO.IS_BONDS_WITH_RIGHTS isBondsWithRights, SEC_INFO.TRADING_CALENDAR tradingCalendar, SEC_INFO.SPECIAL_TERMS specialTerms, RELEASE_INFO.RELEASE_TYPE releaseType,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN RDI_RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_METHOD ELSE RELEASE_INFO.ISSUING_METHOD END AS issueMethod,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN NULL ELSE RELEASE_INFO.BIDDING_METHOD END AS biddingMethod,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN NULL ELSE RELEASE_INFO.TENDER_TARGET END AS tenderTarget,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN NULL ELSE RELEASE_INFO.ADDITIONAL_BATCHES END AS additionalBatches,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN RDI_RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_SIZE * 10000 ELSE ROUND( RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_SIZE / 10000, 2 ) END AS issueSize,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN TO_DATE(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') ELSE TO_DATE(RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') END AS issueDate,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN TO_DATE(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.EVENT_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') ELSE TO_DATE(RELEASE_INFO.PAYMENT_DEADLINE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') END AS paymentDeadline,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN NULL ELSE RELEASE_INFO.DEBT_REGISTRATION_DATE END AS debtRegistrationDate,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN NULL ELSE RELEASE_INFO.LISTING_DATE END AS listingDate,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN NULL ELSE RELEASE_INFO.LISTING_CODE END AS listingCode,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN NULL ELSE SEC_INFO.CROSS_MARKET_CODE END AS crossMarketCode,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN TO_DATE(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.INTEREST_ACCRUAL_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') ELSE TO_DATE(RELEASE_INFO.INTEREST_ACCRUAL_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') END AS interestAccrualDate,
SEC_INFO.VALUE_DATE valueDate, SEC_INFO.EXPIRY_DATE expiryDate, SEC_INFO.PRIMARY_CLASSIFICATION primaryClassification, SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION secondaryClassification, SEC_INFO.VARIETY_OF_COUPONS varietyOfCoupons, SEC_INFO.INTEREST_PAYMENT_FREQUENCY interestPaymentFrequency, SEC_INFO.RATE_TYPE rateType, SEC_INFO.CURRENCY,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN RDI_RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_PX ELSE RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_PX END AS issuePx,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN RDI_RELEASE_INFO.STIPULATION_VALUE ELSE RELEASE_INFO.STIPULATION_VALUE END AS stipulationValue,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN RDI_RELEASE_INFO.SINGLE_MIN_SUB_AMT * 10000 ELSE ROUND( RELEASE_INFO.MIN_PER_TENDER_AMT / 10000, 2 ) END AS singleMinSubAmt,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN RDI_RELEASE_INFO.SINGLE_MAX_SUB_AMT * 10000 ELSE ROUND( RELEASE_INFO.MAX_PER_TENDER_AMT / 10000, 2 ) END AS singleMaxSubAmt,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN RDI_RELEASE_INFO.REMARK ELSE NULL END AS remark,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN RDI_RELEASE_INFO.COUPON_RATE ELSE RELEASE_INFO.COUPON_RATE END AS couponRate,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN RDI_RELEASE_INFO.BENCHMARK_CURVE_NAME ELSE RELEASE_INFO.BENCHMARK_CURVE_NAME END AS benchmarkCurveName,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN RDI_RELEASE_INFO.DECIMAL_PLACES ELSE RELEASE_INFO.DECIMAL_PLACES END AS decimalPlaces,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN RDI_RELEASE_INFO.SPREAD ELSE RELEASE_INFO.SPREAD END AS spread,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN NULL ELSE RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_START_TIME END AS issueStartTime,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN NULL ELSE RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_END_TIME END AS issueEndTime,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN NULL ELSE RELEASE_INFO.BID_DATE END AS bidDate,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN NULL ELSE RELEASE_INFO.ADDITIONAL_TENDER_DATE END AS additionalTenderDate,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN RDI_RELEASE_INFO.MAX_SUB_AMT * 10000 ELSE ROUND( RELEASE_INFO.MAX_SUB_AMT / 10000, 2 ) END AS maxSubAmt,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN RDI_RELEASE_INFO.MIN_PER_TENDER_AMT * 10000 ELSE ROUND( RELEASE_INFO.MIN_PER_TENDER_AMT / 10000, 2 ) END AS minPerTenderAmt,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN RDI_RELEASE_INFO.MAX_PER_TENDER_AMT * 10000 ELSE ROUND( RELEASE_INFO.MAX_PER_TENDER_AMT / 10000, 2 ) END AS maxPerTenderAmt,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN RDI_RELEASE_INFO.MIN_TENDER_PX_FOR_PLAN ELSE RELEASE_INFO.MIN_TENDER_PX_FOR_PLAN END AS minTenderPxForPlan,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN RDI_RELEASE_INFO.MAX_TENDER_PX_FOR_PLAN ELSE RELEASE_INFO.MAX_TENDER_PX_FOR_PLAN END AS maxTenderPxForPlan,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN RDI_RELEASE_INFO.TENDER_STEP ELSE RELEASE_INFO.TENDER_STEP END AS tenderStep,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN RDI_RELEASE_INFO.MEDIAN_MAX_BID_MARKED ELSE RELEASE_INFO.MEDIAN_MAX_BID_MARKED END AS medianMaxBidMarked,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN RDI_RELEASE_INFO.MAX_TENDER_PX_DIFFER ELSE RELEASE_INFO.MAX_TENDER_PX_DIFFER END AS maxTenderPxDiffer,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN RDI_RELEASE_INFO.CONTINUOUS_TENDER_LIMIT ELSE RELEASE_INFO.CONTINUOUS_TENDER_LIMIT END AS continuousTenderLimit,
CASE WHEN SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION IN ( '同业存单', '证券公司短期融资券' ) THEN RDI_RELEASE_INFO.MAX_TOTAL_TENDER_AMT * 10000 ELSE ROUND( RELEASE_INFO.MAX_TOTAL_TENDER_AMT / 10000, 2 ) END AS maxTotalTenderAmt
FROM INTERF_WIND_UNRELEASE_SEC_INFO SEC_INFO --wind一级未发行债券信息接口表 LEFT JOIN INTERF_WIND_RELEASE_INFO RELEASE_INFO ON SEC_INFO.SEC_ID = RELEASE_INFO.SEC_ID --wind一级未发行债券发行信息接口表 LEFT JOIN INTERF_RDI_RELEASE_INFO RDI_RELEASE_INFO ON RDI_RELEASE_INFO.SECURITY_ID = SEC_INFO.SEC_ID --银行间债券再发行信息接口表
SEC_INFO.VALUE_DATE < to_date(#{platformDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND SEC_INFO.SEC_ID = #{secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND SEC_INFO.BOND_ABBREVIATION = #{bondAbbreviation,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
